conbody.p: Choose Google AI Studio as the provider to run an agent on a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio, with no Google sign-in. A workspace admin makes the key in AI Studio and pastes it once on the Google AI Studio card in Workspace settings → AI providers. Agents on Google AI Studio then use that key in every project, whatever the project's agent auth, on every runner, including members' own machines; nobody sets an environment variable. It is the same key the Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI use on API-key auth.

The runner drives the Gemini CLI with the key, so a runner needs the gemini command installed, and the agent behaves as a gemini-cli agent does: the same models, the allowlist applied the same way, no repository access and no effort setting. A run with no key stored and none on the runner fails at once and says to paste one. Usage is billed by Google to the key's AI Studio project.
